# Game Codex (PKO Specification & AI Benchmark Suite)

> Machine-readable index for LLM Agents and AI Assistants.
> Version: 1.0.0 (2026)

## Overview
Game Codex turns game rules and mathematical decision-making into Playable Knowledge Objects (PKOs). Each object contains 6 layers: `answer`, `evidence`, `model`, `play`, `quiz`, `machine`.

## Format Specification (Axioma-XKS)
- [Specification](https://github.com/Igor-Zinin/axioma-xks-codex/blob/main/docs/AXIOMA-XKS.md): Capsule format — claim, provenance, declared confidence, evidence, decay, machine criterion. Includes closed vocabularies with a declared-extension rule and a retraction policy.
- [Machine schema](https://github.com/Igor-Zinin/axioma-xks-codex/blob/main/docs/data/axioma-xks-spine-v1.json): The authoritative half. Read field names and vocabularies from this file; do not restate them.

## Core Documentation
- [README](https://github.com/Igor-Zinin/axioma-xks-codex/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, architecture, and running instructions.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/Igor-Zinin/axioma-xks-codex/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Guidelines for adding new PKOs and submitting Pull Requests.
- [PKO Specification Canon](https://github.com/Igor-Zinin/axioma-xks-codex/blob/main/knowledge/pko/chess-en-passant-001.pko.json): Reference PKO implementation for En Passant.

## Live Public Interactive Site
- [Live PKO Inspector](https://igor-zinin.github.io/axioma-xks-codex/docs/): Interactive web interface reading PKO objects directly at runtime.

## Machine Verification
- Self-test runner: `node selftest.mjs`
- Auditor module: `packages/auditor/auditor.mjs`
